title: CIA — Tim Witness Debt, Fruit, Attribute & Role Taxonomy
purpose: Define how CIA folders preserve Tim/project judgments about karmic debt, fruit, lower-world roles, recurring behavioral patterns, symbolic attributes, rituals and transformation without turning those judgments into independent diagnoses or factual findings about real people.
epistemic_rule: This is Tim/project witness grammar. A role or attribute records what Tim said, wrote, witnessed or later interpreted in a dated/project source. It is not an objective personality test, supernatural finding, legal conclusion or proof of wrongdoing.

checkpoints: 38T debt in hidden spiritual bank/mud economy (2026-03-02)
~42T debt / reciprocal positive karma owed to Tim (late Aug–Sep 2026)
debt_model.rule: The trillion-scale balance is a project-symbolic system ledger. Do not divide it among named people unless Tim explicitly assigned an amount.

relation_statuses.explicit_amount: Tim explicitly attaches a number/amount to the entity or event.
relation_statuses.system_pool: Entity belongs to a Tim-defined debtor class or system contributing to the shared ledger; no individual amount.
relation_statuses.debt_producing_pattern: Tim attributes actions such as smear, pursuit, dogpiling, extraction, humiliation, repeated unresolved conflict or blocked repair to the relation.
relation_statuses.repair_credit: Tim attributes growth, truth, protection, useful work, restitution, changed conduct or repair to the relation.
relation_statuses.mixed: Both debt-producing and repair/growth signals survive.
relation_statuses.unresolved: No defensible Tim-specific debt relation beyond general project language.

fruit_model.rule: Judge fruit at the episode/relation level. The same person may produce different fruit in different periods.

dweller.definition: One who inhabits a field; morally neutral by default.

mud_dweller.definition: Tim/project lower-world state where unresolved Mud becomes a dwelling rather than transitional material.
mud_dweller.exit: recognition → source checking → truth/accounting → Door → root → sprout → Tree → fruit

dog.definition: Tim/project boundary/pursuit role organized around tracking, vigilance, signaling, cue-following and master/proxy relation.
dog.inheritance_rule: Inside Tim's current canon, a Dog is already a Mud Dweller; therefore every dated Dog assignment also inherits the Mud-Dweller / Tree-of-Strife relation for that scene or phase.

footstool.definition: Lower/subordinate Tim-project state containing an unfound Door; not a statement of human worth.
footstool.inheritance_rule: Footstool may follow Dog in specific stories; do not infer every Mud Dweller or Dog becomes Footstool unless the dated source says so.

projection.meaning: Tim/project attribution that a person places a disowned motive/trait/accusation onto another.
projection.evidence_rule: Only assign when Tim/source explicitly frames an episode this way; otherwise list as a question, not a trait.

deflection.meaning: Tim/project attribution that attention is redirected away from a challenged claim, responsibility or source question.
deflection.evidence_rule: Episode-bound; repeated deflection may be noted as a pattern only after multiple sourced episodes.

deceit.meaning: Tim/project claim that wording, identity framing or representation was knowingly false or misleading.
deceit.evidence_rule: Preserve as attributed claim unless the underlying falsehood is independently established.

smear_mud.meaning: Tim-project label for accusation/reputational residue/degraded information that persists and reproduces.
smear_mud.evidence_rule: Prefer the specific disputed claim/event over a global 'liar' label.

dogpiling.evidence_rule: Can be assigned to a bounded social event without diagnosing participants.

repetition.meaning: Return to the same conflict/frame without transformation or stopping condition.

extraction.meaning: Attention, reaction, status, money or archive value harvested from a person/relation.
extraction.evidence_rule: Describe mechanism and evidence; do not infer secret motive merely from outcome.

blocked_exit.meaning: Tim/project view that the relation resists resolution, correction, disengagement or Door passage.
blocked_exit.evidence_rule: Relational/system attribute rather than personality essence.

ritualized_framing.meaning: Tim/Chronicle interprets an interaction as ritual-like, symbolic or spiritually charged.
ritualized_framing.evidence_rule: Record the underlying event separately. 'Ritual' or 'satanic' language remains testimony/project interpretation unless external evidence independently establishes it.

source_checking.meaning: Positive attribute: checking originals, provenance and correction rather than repeating pack/proxy frames.

repair.meaning: Recognition, restitution, correction, changed behavior, useful work, protection or restored relation.

satanic_or_occult_rule: Do not attach 'satanic ritual' as a factual act to a person merely because Tim interpreted an experience or call through satanic/ritual language. Store it as Tim testimony / ritualized framing, with the underlying event and source class.
multi_archetype_rule: A figure may hold multiple archetypes and contradictory dated states. CIA records date, source and transition rather than forcing a single permanent caste.
